conviction_note: Nothing company-level and unpriced was found. The 25% fall in five sessions is sector-driven: Solaria's 19 Nov capital markets day raised financing doubts and the RENIXX lost 10.6% on the week. The 9M release (first since H1 on 16 Sep, bmo 25 Nov) is new numbers in a 67%-vol name, so abs_move is 8. p_up 52 rests only on a weak inference that Q3 will show the Gabriela proceeds against the financing fear, and the company's own 'accelerate capex' statement offsets it. impact_sum +0.4 and the scaled +0.32 agree.

already_public.what: H1 2026 results: net profit EUR74m (+112%), revenue EUR661m, EBITDA EUR126m, net debt EUR1.1bn / 4.6x, ~30% of the 2026-2028 asset-rotation target reached, EUR50m / 500k-share buyback launched; Gabriela (Oasis phase 4) and Colombia sales booked in H1
Business-plan update to 2028: EUR3.7bn capex, no explicit 2026 EBITDA target (per Renta 4 headline/snippet; page unreachable)
Gabriela (Oasis de Atacama phase 4) sale to CVC DIF closed at USD475m EV
USD457-460m financing closed for Oasis phase 5 (446 MW solar + 1.8 GWh storage) in Chile
OIR: 15-year PPA for c.900 GWh/yr (450 MW solar) in Peru from 2029, filed the day before the print

new_in_release.expect: Q3 2026 standalone with no rotation gain booked (Gabriela and Colombia were H1), so a tepid quarter, as Q3 2025 was (EBITDA EUR24.7m). Analysts expect this; direction neutral to slightly negative

First net-debt print after the Gabriela cash (Sep) and before the Chile phase-5 drawdown, against a company statement that capex accelerates in H2. This is the line the Solaria-driven financing scare will be read on; direction unknown, slight positive lean
Possible update on 2026-2028 rotation progress (30% at H1) and a reconfirmation of the 2027 guide; a reconfirmation would be read as a relief, a cut as a large negative. Unknown
Buyback execution to date (500k shares / EUR50m, JB Capital), mildly supportive. Unknown amount

findings.finding: The 9M balance sheet is the first leverage print since the Gabriela sale closed (USD475m EV, 3 Sep 2026) and since the sector-wide financing scare that Solaria's 19 Nov capital markets day set off (Solaria -5.4%, GRE -9.4% on ~5x volume the same day); the release can directly answer the fear the stock was sold on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 9 Oct 2026 the USD457m Chile financing lifted the stock 5.41% (El Periodico de la Energia headline); in the 2025 Q3 'transition quarter' Renta 4 read the leverage and capex as the weak line.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock was sold on peer read-through, not on company numbers: the 19 Nov fall matched Solaria's CMD day and the RENIXX week. GRE has not published a number since 16 Sep. If the market were pricing the Q3 deleveraging, the stock would not sit at May-2025 lows with a 12-analyst average target of EUR118.90. Against this, the company itself said on 16 Sep that capex will accelerate, so net debt may not fall. That caveat is why this is small.
findings.independence: Solaria's drop was on financing doubts (El Periodico de la Energia, https://elperiodicodelaenergia.com/solaria-cae-un-5-4-ante-las-dudas-del-mercado-por-la-financiacion-en-centros-de-datos/). Read-across only.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 is a quarter with no rotation gain: Gabriela and the Colombian sales were booked in H1, and no rotation closed in Q3. Standalone Q3 EBITDA and profit will be small, as in Q3 2025 (EBITDA EUR24.7m, called 'tibio' by Renta 4).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 9M 2025 (late Nov 2025) was framed as a 'transition quarter' and Renta 4 held Infraponderar. The baseline's estimated history does not isolate that day.
findings.original_quote: El desempeño de Grenergy en el primer semestre se vio impulsado principalmente por las recientes rotaciones de activos, entre las que destacan el cierre de la venta de Gabriela ... y la venta de siete activos solares de distribución en Colombia (the H1 performance was driven mainly by the recent asset rotations, notably the closing of the Gabriela sale and the sale of seven distributed solar assets in Colombia)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The sell-side knows the rotations sit in H1, and the 9M year-on-year comparison will still flatter (H1 profit doubled). The residual is the headline risk of a weak Q3 standalone, so the size is near 0.

findings.finding: Disclosed hedge-fund positioning is two-sided into the print. JP Morgan's net short built from 0.51% (1 Oct) to 1.36% (19 Nov) on the CNMV register. Point72 disclosed a 1.011% long via equity swaps (notified 13 Nov), before the latest 25% fall.
findings.original_quote: Se trata de JP Morgan que sigue incrementando sus 'cortos' desde el 0,51% que tenia el pasado uno de octubre ... a fecha 19 del mes en curso ostentaba una posicion bajista del 1,36% (It is JP Morgan, which keeps increasing its shorts from the 0.51% it held on 1 October; as of the 19th of this month it held a short position of 1.36%)
findings.why_not_priced: The short build is visible in the price, which fell with it. 1.36% from one holder is not crowded enough to be squeeze fuel, and the Point72 long offsets it. Net near zero.

findings.finding: The day before the print, Grenergy filed an OIR for a 15-year PPA of c.900 GWh/yr for 450 MW of solar in Peru, starting 2029. It is likely to be repeated in the release as a contracting milestone.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 3.26% intraday on the filing day (24 Nov, partial session at seal) while Solaria fell 5.0%, so the filing was absorbed by sector flow.
findings.original_quote: HECHOS RELEVANTES.-GRENERGY RENOVABLES, S.A. Grenergy firma un PPA solar de c. 900 GWh/ano para 450 MW. (Bolsamania headline)
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and was priced on 24 Nov. Revenue starts in 2029, so nothing lands on this period. Near zero.
findings.independence: Renewables Now, Review Energy and BNamericas (land secured for the USD105m park, 23 Nov) reported it separately; all rest on one company release.

findings.finding: A buyback of up to EUR50m / 500k shares (1.7% of capital) has run since 16 Sep via JB Capital. At about EUR50 the full 500k shares cost only about EUR25m, and the release should report how much has been bought.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Announced with H1 on 16 Sep; the stock rose about 3% at the open that day.
findings.original_quote: Mediante este programa, que arranca hoy mismo, Grenergy pretende adquirir 500.000 acciones propias, representativas de aproximadamente el 1,7% de su capital social. El programa ... sera gestionado por JB Capital Markets (Through this programme, which starts today, Grenergy intends to buy 500,000 own shares, about 1.7% of its share capital; JB Capital Markets will manage it)
findings.why_not_priced: The programme is public. Its execution pace is not visible to me (weekly reports not found), so only a small residual is left.

baseline_tension: The run-up lean (-23% over 20 days, so the free control says up) and my findings agree only weakly. Nothing found explains or reverses a sector-driven de-rating, so the small positive comes from inference rather than from a sourced unpriced number.
language_note: Valencia Plaza (Spanish) carried the CNMV short-register reading: JP Morgan building from 0.51% to 1.36% by 19 Nov. No English source had it, and it is the only positioning datum on a name whose register is unreachable from here.

Spanish wire headlines carried the session ('con apertura de mercado el 25 de noviembre') and the OIR classification of the Peru PPA. The English items carried the PPA but not the filing channel or the session.

Spanish coverage (Forbes Espana/EP) carried the buyback terms (500k shares, JB Capital, liquidity contract suspended) and the H1 attribution to the Gabriela/Colombia rotations. These set up the 'Q3 has no rotation' reading.
The Solaria CMD explanation for the 19 Nov sector fall came from Spanish sources (El Periodico de la Energia, Benzinga ES); the English results only showed the RENIXX weekly headline.
lessons_applied: 'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' and 'the hunter's own caveat has to reach the number': the deleveraging finding fell from +0.8 to +0.4, because the company's own 'capex accelerates' statement cuts against it.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not the thing to agree with': the JPM short-build finding fell from -0.3 to -0.1, since the price already reflects it and 1.36% is not crowded.

'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the tepid-Q3 finding (rotations already disclosed as H1) fell from -0.3 to -0.1, and the public Peru PPA and buyback findings each fell from +0.2 to +0.1.
'The move is in the guide' / 'too small about the move': abs_move_pct rose from 7 to 8, because the 9M numbers are new, a rotation or 2027-guide update is possible, and 20-day realised vol is 67%.
